newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk Tofas says no change in ownership.
newsitem.headline: Turk Tofas says no change in ownership.

text.p: Turkey's leading car maker Tofas Turk Otomobil Fabrikasi A.S. said on Monday there would be no change in the company ownership structure under which major partners Turkish Koc Holding and Italian Fiat each hold a 37.86 percent stake.

"In talks between our partners Koc Holding and Fiat Auto SpA on March 20, an agreement was reached by the sides that operations be continued without any change in Tofas's partnership structure or relations," Tofas said in a statement sent to the Istanbul Stock Exchange.
Tofas shares were the most heavily traded ones on Monday amid market expectations of a sale of Tofas stake between the partners.
Its shares brushed a high of 10,500 lira in the morning, versus Friday's 9,800 close, but dived to 8,900 in the afternoon in reaction to the company's statement.
